summary: The diff implements the vast majority of all four requirements. REQ-1 (unified number) is applied across Header, Footer, BusinessHighlightsStrip, HotPickSection, ContactPage, ServicesPage, ProductsPage, WhatsAppQuickMessages, and all new sub-pages. REQ-2 (dropdown navigation + routes) is implemented in Header.tsx with desktop dropdown and mobile collapsible menus, and App.tsx registers all submenu routes. REQ-3 (individual sub-page components with SEO, structured data, and CTAs) is implemented for all 14 sub-routes. REQ-4 (GA4 page_view on navigation) is handled in App.tsx's navigate() function firing gtag page_view on every pushState, plus initializeSPAPageViews(). One minor gap is that robots.txt is not visible in the diff. Overall, implementation is very comprehensive.

missing_requirements.requirement: robots.txt must be updated to include all new page URLs
